definitions.explanation: The process of coordinating or aligning different elements, opinions, or schedules to reach agreement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{擦|す}り{合|あ}わせ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{擦|す}り{合|あ}わせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しましょう→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{各部署|かくぶしょ}→各部署：29114_kakubusho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{擦|す}り{合|あ}わせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Coordinating with each department took time.

notes:
A key concept in Japanese business culture referring to the process of aligning opinions, schedules, or plans among multiple parties before a final decision is made.

ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "rubbing together" — from {擦|す}り{合|あ}わせる (to rub/grind surfaces together to fit). The original meaning refers to physical fitting of parts; the business meaning is metaphorical.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {擦|す}り{合|あ}わせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct coordination
- {擦|す}り{合|あ}わせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to coordinate (less formal)
- ⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{擦|す}り{合|あ}わせ: coordination with stakeholders
- ⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{擦|す}り{合|あ}わせ: schedule alignment

FORMS:
{擦|す}り{合|あ}わせる (to coordinate, to fine-tune)

Frequent in workplace and organizational settings. Reflects the Japanese emphasis on consensus-building (⟦{根回|ねまわ}し→根回し：07727_nemawashi⟧) before formal meetings.
